modelleertaal:
N = 1000
G = 6,674e-11 '[N m^2/kg^2] x = 7,58e6 '[m] y = 0 '[m]
vx = 0 '[m/s] vy = 8000 '[m/s]
M = 5,97e24 '[kg] m = 1 '[kg]
t = 0 '[s] dt = 10 '[s]
r = sqrt(x^2 + y^2) '[m] Fg = G * M * m / r^2 '[N]
Fr = -Fg '[N] a = Fr/m '[m/s^2]
ay = a * y/r '[m/s^2] ax = a * x/r '[m/s^2]
vx = vx + ax * dt vy = vy + ay * dt
x = x + vx * dt y = y + vy * dt
t = t + dt
